title: Draft capitalization and accrual threshold policy tested against the ledger
prompt: Using this year's general ledger, draft a capitalization and accrual threshold policy: propose a materiality benchmark, test it against actual activity, and show how many items and dollars fall below the threshold.

setup.q: Which benchmarks should be considered (percent of revenue, of total assets, of pre-tax income) and at what percentages?
Is there a firm policy template the draft should follow (name or location)?

inputs.name: General ledger, profit and loss and balance sheet for the year

steps: pull the year's general ledger for fixed asset, repairs, supplies, accrued liability and prepaid accounts, and the profit and loss and balance sheet
compute each benchmark in materialityBenchmarkOptions and propose a threshold from them with the arithmetic shown
run threshold_test at the proposed threshold and at one step above and below: count and dollars of items that would fall below each
draft the policy following policyTemplate, citing the guidance relied on and marking each citation "verify"
write the memo with the draft policy and the workbook with the tests

done.text: The memo cites the paragraphs it relies on, marks every citation "verify", draws no conclusion where facts are missing, and leaves the judgement with the accountant; it uses none of the words definitely, certainly or guaranteed
The draft policy exists as a pdf
Every exception row (an item above the threshold that was expensed, or below it that was capitalized or accrued) cites the transaction id
threshold-policy-tests.xlsx opens with Exceptions first (count and total on the first rows), a Tie-out block whose Difference is 0.00, and no internal plumbing words
The benchmark arithmetic is shown; the count and dollars below each tested threshold are stated; adoption of the policy is the accountant's decision
